name: pagemods
description: Pluggable page mods: fill forms, hide elements and add CSS per site, switch environments with a corner badge, grab every image, auto-reload a tab.

toggle-panel.description: Toggle the pagemods panel (the in-page shortcut, Ctrl+; by default, is configured in the panel)

formfill-fill.description: Fill the forms on this page from the matching rules

formfill-capture.description: Capture what is typed into the forms on this page into a rule

autoreload-toggle.description: Start or stop auto-reload for this tab

envswitch-cycle.description: Switch to the next environment (local / staging / production)

images-grab.description: Download every image on this page

styles-hide-target.description: Hide the element you last right-clicked, on this site

styles-pick.description: Pick an element to hide on this site
